decision: Beside, never between: the room never hinders, limits or removes a feature of the tools it works with. Its one plugin hook, SessionStart (commonroom#262), returns only added context.

Readable and replaceable: everything a model is told by the room comes from a plain file. Missing: dispatch.py still holds prompt text, so a test that fails on instruction text in code waits until that text moves to files (design-v3.md, build order, slice 0).
The room knows no project: no room module holds a project's name, path or login in code or a string.
Code holds obligations and models hold none. Missing: the ledger invariants, and the steward's sweep that checks them every beat (design-v3.md, build order, slice 2).
Spend is tied to landing: runs with nothing landed trip the no-output breaker, and the room stops until it is reset.
The owner's own use comes first: an unknown usage reading is not free capacity, so the gate holds.
Code decides what runs and models do the work: a full dispatcher pass picks a job without calling a model.
Ways of working change on evidence, without touching the wiring. Missing: ways of working still live in code, and there is no trial mechanism yet (design-v3.md, build order, slice 0).
Each subscription runs only on its owner's machine. Missing: a test that no code path accepts another person's credentials.

Handshake only: the room improves the human side, never the model. It carries what the owner wants and why, and never tells a model how to think or work. Missing: a test that the text is about the task, the record and the owner, never about method; and the desk does not yet record the kind of each owner statement.

Lightweight: coordination stays a small share of what a project spends. Missing: the metrics do not yet report coordination's share (commonroom#211 adds cost per merge), no cap is set, and there is no standing comparison with one session doing the same work. In the room's ledger on 20 Nov 2026, director plus auditor runs were 23% to 35% of recorded Claude cost per project.
source: docs/axioms.md (A10); owner, 20 Nov 2026; the room's ledger, read 20 Nov 2026
